how: Opened the public Gemini share page and selected the longest response (a <message-content> element: 52 math nodes) with a DOM range, then ran document.execCommand("copy"). The shared (signed-out) view has no per-response copy button, only "Copy prompt" on user turns, so there is no copy-button capture.
notes: Gemini share page selection: 26 math nodes (data-math) with KaTeX markup (154 katex-classed nodes), lists, 120 KB HTML.
